examples.title: Draft a wrapper feature request (never submitted)

description: Produce a LOCAL GitHub issue draft + compliance report for zipnative / zipnative-mcp and NEVER submit it — the agent drafts, a human reviews and files it under their own identity (Human-In-The-Loop contract, .github/AGENT_RULES.md). No GitHub write path and no network path exist in this server. The draft is checked against the zero-dependency + reproduction policy; a policy violation (a new runtime dependency, duplicateSearchPerformed:false) is GOVERNANCE_VIOLATION; a missing field (reproduction included) is VALIDATION_ERROR. targetRepo 'zipnative' for engine behaviour (parsing, writing, limits, codecs), 'zipnative-mcp' for wrapper behaviour (schemas, sandbox, transport). Returns markdown inline (outputMode:'file' also writes a .md inside the sandbox). Use it only after reproducing a defect — for questions read describe_engine / docs/AGENT_CONTRACT.md instead. Present the draft AND the report to the user, then STOP.

actualBehavior.description: What actually happened (defaults to the reproduction result when omitted).

duplicateSearchPerformed.description: MUST be true: confirms you searched open AND closed issues/PRs for duplicates before drafting.

expectedBehavior.description: What you expected to happen instead.

outputMode.description: 'inline' (default) returns the draft markdown in the response. 'file' additionally writes it to the sandbox (requires ZIPNATIVE_MCP_OUTPUT_DIR); outputPath must be a relative .md path.

outputPath.description: Relative .md path inside the sandbox (only when outputMode='file').

reproduction.description: The minimal, locally-executed reproduction that justifies this issue.

command.description: The exact command or MCP tool call you ran.

result.description: The observed failure, error, or regression.

summary.description: One or two paragraphs describing the problem or proposal.

targetRepo.description: Destination repository label for the draft (documentation only — the server never contacts it). 'zipnative-mcp' (wrapper: schemas, sandbox, transport) or 'zipnative' (engine: parser, writer, limits, codecs).

title.description: Concise issue title (imperative, no trailing period).

name: draft_governance_issue

outputSchema.description: A local, unsubmitted issue draft plus its compliance report. The server NEVER opens the issue — a human must review and submit it.

draftMarkdown.description: The full draft, ready for a human to review and submit.
